patch_description:
Replace the CZ line entanglement with a staggered ring (even pairs + odd pairs including 7→0 closure) plus cross connections (0↔4, 1↔5, 2↔6, 3↔7). Insert an RX rotation layer between the two entanglement stages. This gives:
1. Ring closure + cross connections reduce the effective "diameter" of the qubit graph from 7 to 2 hops
2. RX layer between entanglement stages adds a third rotation axis, providing full SU(2) single-qubit coverage
3. Staggered CZ pattern is more parallelizable (lower depth per entanglement stage)
4. 32 params/block × 6 blocks + 2 readout = 194 total params (modest increase from 146)
